caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden box with a front-facing door and hardware. The box is rendered in shades of brown, indicating a natural wood texture with visible grain and knots. The door on the front has two horizontal metal latch mechanisms, one positioned near the top and the other in the middle, both with visible hinges and securing hardware. There is a prominent wooden handle attached to the left side of the door. Below the main door, there is a rectangular open compartment or slot with a hinged panel that appears to be able to swing outward. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is printed in uppercase letters at the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Pa. German Wall Corner Cupboard
